description: A compartmental SIR (Susceptible-Infected-Recovered) model representing the dynamics of disease spread in a homogeneous, well-mixed population of 1,000 individuals. The population is divided into three groups (S, I, R), and the transitions between compartments are governed by differential equations based on transmission and recovery rates.

behaviors.name: transmit_infection
behaviors.description: Susceptible individuals become infected at a rate proportional to the number of infected and susceptible individuals, scaled by the transmission rate parameter (beta).
behaviors.algorithm: Each time step, compute new infections as: new_infections = beta * S * I / N

behaviors.name: recover
behaviors.description: Infected individuals recover at a rate proportional to the number of infected individuals, scaled by the recovery rate parameter (gamma).
behaviors.algorithm: Each time step, compute new recoveries as: new_recoveries = gamma * I

interactions.name: Disease Transmission
interactions.description: The process by which susceptible individuals become infected through contact with infected individuals, as described by the SIR model equations.
interactions.effect: Decrease susceptible count, increase infected count

interactions.name: Recovery
interactions.description: The process by which infected individuals move to the recovered compartment.
interactions.effect: Decrease infected count, increase recovered count

algorithms.SIR_update:
At each time step, update S, I, and R via: 
  new_infections = beta * S * I / N 
  new_recoveries = gamma * I 
  S = S - new_infections 
  I = I + new_infections - new_recoveries 
  R = R + new_recoveries
algorithms.metrics_tracking: At each time step, record the number of infected individuals. After simulation, compute peak infection (max infected at any time) and final epidemic size (total who were infected: initial susceptible - final susceptible).

files.name: main.py
files.description: Entry point for simulation; handles parameter setup, runs the SIR model, and outputs results.

files.name: sir_model.py
files.description: Contains the SIR model logic, including the update step for each compartment and metrics calculation.

files.name: plot_results.py
files.description: Handles visualization of simulation outputs (number infected over time, etc).
